Can you include images to be converted to base64?

I've looked into this and it's basically not possible. Rather than individual "images" all of the Cashmere graphics are implemented as a font. This font exists in multiple formats and has a total of four URLs necessary for good browser support. Each file is about 12kB.

Here's how it currently works... When you use a subverse with Cashmere installed on it, your browser looks at the CSS and downloads only the font format it wants. It then caches that file so it doesn't have to download it on every page load.

If they were base64, the encoding for all four URLs would have to be in the CSS. This would be very large, about 64kB (12kB * 4 * 1.33). The +33% is due to base64's overhead. That alone is longer than the 50000 character limit for custom CSS. Even if Voat had no limit, it wouldn't be great for them to be serving those extra 64kB on every page load.

Ideally, Voat would serve a subverse's custom CSS as an external <link> in the HTML instead of inlining it as they do currently. This would allow the stylesheet to be cached and minimize the problem above, but base64 will always be somewhat problematic because it turns every 3 bits into 4 and it can't be cached directly.
